name: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited

facts.business: R M Drip and Sprinklers Systems Limited designs, manufactures, and installs drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for farmers.

capacity_or_capex.item: Installation of modern machinery to enhance production efficiency

key_risks: Withdrawal or reduction of government subsidies
Dependence on monsoon and seasonal variability
Cyclical nature of agricultural income impacting farmers' purchasing power
Intense competition from the unorganized sector
Uneven rainfall distribution and adverse climatic conditions
